note: The pcap record header supplies an input-controlled captured length of 1, so only one packet byte is read into p->buffer.
The packet with link type DLT_USB_LINUX_MMAPPED and caplen 1 is passed to the USB packet-header fixup code without a prior full-metadata-header check.
The one-byte packet buffer is treated as a pcap_usb_header_mmapped even though hdr->caplen is smaller than sizeof(pcap_usb_header_mmapped).
The input pcap global header selects DLT_USB_LINUX_MMAPPED, enabling the vulnerable USB mmapped fixup branch.
The code should have verified hdr->caplen is at least sizeof(pcap_usb_header_mmapped) before dereferencing usb_hdr fields.
Dereferencing usb_hdr->data_flag reads past the one captured packet byte, using an incomplete USB mmapped metadata header.
